title: EnsureTryItWorkspaceCallablePayload
description: Command workspace.ensure (contracts/commands/catalog.json). A phone-verified caller gets their one try-it workspace: a private, unpublished organizer they own, the same record createOrganizer makes. The website's phone step sends the brand name and city; every try-it tool then writes into this organizer.

organizerName.description: The organizer's brand name. Used only when the workspace is created; an existing workspace keeps its name.
